new_value: Fixed: Updated Rule 7 table in 03-adaptation.md to match the actual implementation in codec.rs. The table now correctly shows the address-mode bit (1 bit for link-local vs global), conditional address sizes (64-bit IID for link-local, 128-bit for global), direction bit (which port is 10883), and OtherPort field. Updated compressed size from incorrect 18 bytes to 21 bytes (link-local) / 37 bytes (global).
